cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-popular-loads-rows-and-status
cases.purpose: Loading the popular feed replaces the rows with the parsed reply and reports the count on the status line.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-search-carries-keyword-and-replaces-rows
cases.purpose: Searching sends the keyword to the backend, shows the reply, and ignores blank input without sending a request.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-selection-moves-and-clamps
cases.purpose: Selection moves one row at a time and clamps at both ends of the list.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-play-selected-delivers-stream-source
cases.purpose: Playing the selected row resolves the stream source (URL plus CDN headers) and hands it to the caller.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-play-failure-only-changes-status
cases.purpose: A failed stream lookup reports on the status line and never calls the playback callback.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-wbi-query-signs-encode-uri-component
cases.purpose: WBI signing sorts keys, encodes like encodeURIComponent and appends the documented w_rid; missing keys signal an error.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-parse-videos-normalizes-rows
cases.purpose: Response parsing cleans search markup, converts string clocks to seconds and reads both the list and result array shapes.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-catalog-controls-and-scrolling
cases.purpose: Scroll continuously from the first to the last mounted card and back, then open and close details through catalog targets.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-search-editing-keeps-application-keys
cases.purpose: Type application shortcut characters in the inline search field and submit without triggering application commands.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-empty-error-and-stale-results
cases.purpose: Empty successful results clear the old library and stale searches cannot restore it.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-latest-play-request-wins
cases.purpose: Only the newest stream resolution reaches playback when replies arrive out of order.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-close-ignores-pending-response
cases.purpose: Closing a loading gallery prevents a late callback from resurrecting it.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-theme-preserves-frame-and-query
cases.purpose: Theme switching preserves the library and leaves frame decoration and the user theme unchanged.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-cover-cache-and-transfer-failure
cases.purpose: The public cover operation downloads through an offline curl fixture, reuses cached files and removes failed partial transfers.
